terms.meaning: Numeric/logical value zero; valid observed value.
Valid operation that intentionally causes no state mutation.
Named semantic state indicating void/absence-space where explicitly defined by the producer.
Information or evidence not observed/proven; never coerced to zero or false.

invariants: ZERO != NOOP != VOID != TOKEN_VAZIO != EMPTY != NULL
